doctrine: Accepted broad identity (brief section 6.5): an unusual hidden victory function, escalating corruption, weather and terrain influence, weighted assistance events and a summoning endgame. The staged operating model is Provisional (brief section 20): proposed stages are Hidden (recruitment and infiltration, dreams and secrets, isolated corruption, hidden ritual anchors, avoidance of direct confrontation), Emerging (connected corrupted regions, monster production, weather destabilization, attacks on weakened settlements, protection of ritual infrastructure) and Dominant (open territorial expansion, destruction of containment, isolation of enemies, summoning preparation, final ritual defense). Proposed economy: corruption, fear, death, captives, secrets, magical sites, ritual materials, compromised people, storms, abandoned settlements. Prose only; nothing in the strategy tree may branch on it before S15.
victory_conditions: Accepted (brief section 6.5 victory pressure): corrupt the island sufficiently to complete the summoning of the major threat. The rules that would carry it out -- early-elimination and summoning-interruption -- are Open (brief section 20).

notes: Accepted (brief section 6.5): the broad identity and the victory pressure. Provisional (brief section 20): the staged operating model, summarized in the doctrine note.
